sample_count.description: Number of samples to collect (cpustat [delay] [count]); null means infinite

all_cpus.description: Scale CPU utilization by number of CPUs (-a)

comm_field.description: Get command info from process comm field (-c)

strip_dirname.description: Strip directory basename from command info (-d)

show_distribution.description: Compute and show distribution of CPU utilisation by task and CPU (-D)

grand_total.description: Show grand total CPU utilisation at end of run (-g)

quiet.description: Run quietly, only meaningful with CSV output (-q)

csv_output.description: Output CSV file path for gathered data (-r)

timestamp.description: Show timestamp (adds time column in CSV if used with -r) (-S)

cpu_threshold.description: Ignore samples where CPU usage delta per second < threshold (-t)

extra_stats.description: Show extra CPU statistics (load average, CPU freq, online CPUs) (-x)
